description: Builds a license and rights page from the document's own attributes, placed after the body and before the back cover. Set :license: to switch it on; :copyright:, :publisher:, :edition: and :isbn: are added beneath it when present and omitted when absent. The page carries no running header or footer, following the convention for a rights page.

themeKeys.description: Alignment of the license page's text.
Colour of the license page's text. Defaults to the document's body colour.

sampleContent: A license page is generated from the document's :license:, :copyright:, :publisher:, :edition: and :isbn: attributes.
